title: Understanding KDE Bandwidth
text: The bandwidth in a KDE plot controls the smoothness of the estimated distribution. A larger bandwidth can oversmooth the data, making distinct peaks less visible.

title: Effect of Bandwidth on Distribution
text: If the bandwidth is too large, the KDE plot may not accurately reflect the true distribution of the data, potentially masking multiple modes.

hintAnswer: The plot becomes oversmoothed, resembling a normal distribution.
title: Identifying the Problem
text: What happens to the KDE plot when the bandwidth is too large?
choices: The plot becomes oversmoothed, resembling a normal distribution.
The plot becomes too jagged, showing too many peaks.

hintAnswer: Decrease the bandwidth to capture more details of the distribution.
title: Choosing the Correct Bandwidth
text: How can you adjust the bandwidth to better reflect a multimodal distribution?
choices: Increase the bandwidth to smooth out the distribution.
Decrease the bandwidth to capture more details of the distribution.
